notes.title: UWD News #4: Happy New Year
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone!
💬 May the New Year bring you happiness and more cool games and fewer bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/a70d61bf04dabc080cbc4feca5258cc626c4cee5.jpg[/img]

I have to admit that the period of December-January is not the most productive time for us, but we still don’t stop on our work, and since I’m here, this is a great time to share some stuff with you.


[h3]🔧Safe place [/h3]
The space of the beginning area has been significantly expanded so that there is room for new improvements, and on the outskirts of the base, a handcar awaits the player to take him on the mission. The function of the hero selection is also moved from the UI into a safe place. This is the part of our work on making this zone an atmospheric interactive place where players rest between game sessions and choose starting perks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36259827/4d6205b730aa22c00ee1781419f2a8ada05dfc98.png [/img]

[h3]🔧Improved controls [/h3]
There are situations when several spots available for sending workers are located nearby, In the current version, it is impossible to send followers to work to a distant spot, even if at the nearest point all working places are occupied, This can be seen on the gif below. Because of this, it was necessary to move closer to the farthest point so that it became "active"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36259827/ba2e053dd450c2d28a4c6b2f46ea41e1862ecfd5.gif [/img]

Now, this situation does not arise and units management has become more dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36259827/8d1cf73e75a35ff674c51748860caa7fbf169b71.gif [/img]

And a couple of sneak pics from the level. On the first GIF, there is also a new obstacle: the diggers must clear the way so that the squad can move on,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36259827/9958096c0061f8ba72855d5d32d8bd4b94ee7dfa.gif [/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /36259827/e133177448f869ebd12a8661f380827b535c4280.gif [/img]

I wish to show you more, but there is still work we want to finish  and until then 
take care of yourself and see you in 2022!

notes.title: UWD News #3: Plans for November
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The picture below shows what happens behind the scenes when you lose in Until We Die :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/3a525966c1bb56be271558eade93cf173c2f8cda.png[/img]

🔧 We will spend the coming weeks assembling a playable version of the following scenario and won't post anything. Don't worry. We are here, but we want to prepare more materials and show the gameplay for our next show-up. Game videos, living pictures... all the good stuff like the animation below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/15924ac8f5a5ca7fee4c868ff88c585ae6037292.gif[/img]

🔧 Unfortunately, the scenario update won't be released this year. I think it is better to warn about this in advance. Even if we technically manage to finish it, we will not publish such a big update without playtests and until we go through everything ourselves. It was the case on the release of the game and will be so with every major update.

💬 In the meantime, I will answer some of the questions raised from time to time:

[b]1. After gameover, the player appears into a wagon that gives passive bonuses. Will there be something similar for the second scenario?[/b]
- Yes! Each scenario will give bonuses, but the wagon was sharpened only for the first scenario. We have to scale it so that it fits logically into the increased size of the game.

[b]2. Will the first scenario be affected by the update?[/b]
- UI and laboratory will be affected.  You can read more about this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1197570]here[/url].
We are also thinking about quickly commanding units to move from one edge of the map to the other. In our opinion, such a need arises during the last wave, when one of the walls withstood, and the defenders prematurely celebrate the victory :)

[b]3. Is it possible to select the nearest units by type by pressing the keys 1, 2, 3 on the keyboard?[/b]
- Yes, we will add this feature.

[b]4. Will the flamethrower be added as a hero or a unit?[/b]
- The flamethrower will be a playable character. New characters won't be active by default. They will need to be found and rescued in the game first. After that, the character will become available for selection. When "rescuing," the player may immediately change the hero in the game for the found one. This system will apply to all added characters.

[b]5. Will there be multiplayer?[/b]
- No, there will be no multiplayer. Next year, we have plans to work on the content and port the game to Nintendo Switch.

[b]6. The hero runs too slowly. Is it possible to increase his speed? [/b]
- The heroes' speed is calculated so that the game is beatable on all difficulty modes. It's balanced and playtested.

[b]7. Will an endless game mode be added?[/b]
- We may add Endless game mode after the release of the second scenario.

That's all I wanted to tell you for today :)
Thank you so much for being attentive, and have a great weekend, everyone!

tags.feature: - Yes, we will add this feature.

notes.title: UWD News #1 - Interfaces & New enemies
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today I would like to share with you a sneak peek of what we have been hard at work lately. Unfortunately,  the update won't be ready in November, that is certain. 

With that out of the way, let’s dig together into what we are doing!


[h2]Interfaces[/h2]
When we started working on the new scenario, we quickly realized the limitations of the current UI and what features we would like to add. For example, bonuses that players unlock for overcoming a challenge or completing a task were hard to keep track of. Sometimes it's beneficial to read about the effects of bonuses that were already taken in the past to get a better understanding of what to take next.

With the new interface, the players can now easily access information with class and style! Furthermore, this template will serve as a backbone for other menus with upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/07ac36207b51930cdf59a12a2f6be75f648073bf.png[/img]


[h2]The Laboratory[/h2]
The laboratory UI is also getting a visual overhaul. Players will be able now to view already researched and yet to be discovered technologies. In addition, the laboratory can now operate without engineers, but it will be very ineffective in terms of the speed of the research.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/898c2a1bbf0752643e0daebb3e4f04e90d0b7e8d.png[/img]

[h2]New Scenarios Structure[/h2]
We have come up with a new way to structure the game’s scenarios. They are no longer directly related to each other and take place at different times. The scenarios are divided according to the seasons of the year: summer, autumn, winter and spring. This brings us to the second scenario: Autumn.


[h2]Autumn Scenario[/h2]
The scenario takes place at the Ploshchad Revolyutsii station, that produces food rations. Recently the station's residents have stopped sending supplies and stay silent. You are sent to find out the fate of the station and it inhabitants.

In this scenario players will also encounter a new type of foe: The fanatic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/d716e21f9b904a26c321703d944ef7cb5a22f63b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/09feffa93fc91b7fe5413b8275082ae61bec372f.png[/img]

For most of us, the arrival of the aliens was the end of the world, but for some it was a chance to begin anew, some even say that they have been waiting for it. These individuals gave their minds and humanity willingly to the invaders and became something in-between: a shell of a human with the malice of a mutant.


[h2]How is the team doing?[/h2]
I have delegated some of my work on the game’s code to my teammate Allexeee. This allows me to take a step back and  have more time to think about what we are doing, rather than how we are doing it. Worry not, I still program a lot, but it has more to do with system, experimentation and research than production.

Content-wise, it takes us, on average, one working week to draw a complex animated object. This includes planning, concepts, animation. Unlike in the case of game design, the time of content creation is fairly predictable and linear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/a0c2283f2474d12ca7f986f1b4e5f61b85e36e61.png[/img]


[h2]So what is the hold up?[/h2]
The game save system is proving to be problematic to say the least. We need to be certain that the new update will not break anything. 



Stay tuned for this update’s news  and until then: stay safe, comrades.

notes.title: The Roadmap for Until We Die
notes.content:
Hello, Comrades! In case you don't like reading here is a video for you!
[previewyoutube=uLm3rc91JFo;full][/previewyoutube]

So it's time to talk a little about the roadmap and related stuff.  
All dates are estimated because we aim for quality, not speed and we will begin to work on our pace after a small vacation that we want to have with our families. We will be back to work in July.

[h3] 🚀 The Roadmap [/h3]
[list]
[*] September, 2021:  new map + new playable character, flamethrower. This map will be more intense and focused on capturing the station.
[*] Early 2022: two new maps, including surface map + dog pets, German shepherds as supportive companions + Nintendo Switch Port.
[/list]

New maps will be shorter then the first one. 

[h3] 💵 Price & Discount policy [/h3]
[list]
[*] Only small discounts around 10-15%
[*] All the new content will be free for our customers and added as updates to the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36259827/85f74e023fa346a19048beb667af4a5340e7f20d.png[/img] 
Woof-Woof

💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Szv4eTA

Best,

notes.title: Patch v. 2021.06.28 with Auto Save system
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's Pixeye. Long story short - the update with saves is LIVE. 

[h3]🐞 Bug fixes[/h3]

- 👏 Fixed a situation where enemies could push the player out of the map
- Fixed situation when select sound plays twice

[h3]🔥 Changes[/h3]

- Added autosave system. The game is saved every morning and when you try to close it except when you are in the title screen or tutorial mode. You will start playing from the place you quit the game.
- Added second work slot to the research lab. The player can set 2 engineers on researches
- 👏Research will be automatically continued in case the player has enough blue flasks
- The research time changed. The first 4 technologies take 27 hours to learn each, the next two tech takes 40.5 hours each, and the last 2 technologies take 54 hours to learn each.
- 👏Diggers are sorted from smallest to the highest rank (For farms and workbench)
- 👏Diggers hit eggs behind the walls
- All units get extra speedup for 2 seconds while retreating from the wall

[h3]📗 Localization[/h3]

- Title label in the Story menu is fixed for English, Japanese and Chinese
- Minor fixes in German localization
- Added Turkish localization

👏 - Based on community feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
It's our first release on Steam and boy it was awkward! The hotfix addresses many silly bugs you could encounter including falling down from the second floor, blocking constructions, playing battle music in background after battle, glitches with Chinese fonts, the reversed direction of the rat swarm in big wave and so on.

[h3]So what can you expect from us in the future?[/h3]
We would like to work more on localization, add Turkish language, also we would be happy to test and publish game for Macs and Linux systems. At a regular basis we will fix bugs. At some point of time we will begin to work on new game modes with stations, new heroes and enemies to deal with. We would also would like to add pets dogs. 

Fun fact - many players want to jump in Until We Die. Dunno why.

The game wouldn't be there without help of  some wonderful people I simply must mention.

notes.title: Demo is coming on May 11th!
notes.content:
Hi all, My name’s Mitya, and I’m a developer on Until We Die, or UWD. The last few months have been very productive for our little studio: we’ve fixed some bugs, completed UWD with out beta-testers on all difficulty levels, improved the balance of the game, and won several categories at [url=https://indiecup.net/en/winners]Indie Cup[/url]. 
Now we’re ready to invite everyone to play the demo version of Until We Die!

[h3]When is the demo version released?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The demo version will be available from May 11, 2021, 12:00 p.m. UTC and will remain active right up until the release of the game.
[/list]
[h3]What will be in the demo version?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The demo version will be released on Windows and will have all the languages that appear in the full version of the game.
[*] The demo comprises the introductory part of the game with one big attack on the player’s station at the end, as well a tutorial and one difficulty mode—“Experienced”. This is a reasonably hard option for players with experience playing games of this genre. A description of the details of the difficulty mode can be found in the game itself.
[/list]
[h3]What next?[/h3]
Right now, I’m heading back to work on the game :) When the demo version is released, I’ll share with you the date of the full game release, and also tell you about our plans for updates after the game is released.

All of us at Pixeye Games really hope that you enjoy playing Until We Die. See you in a week’s time!
